# Oliver Parks

> Oliver Parks is an executive search and talent consulting group, founded in 2012, recruiting experienced professionals and executive leadership for technology, infrastructure, med-tech and engineering across Europe and the US.

## Divisions
- OP Technology: ERP (SAP, Microsoft Dynamics), CRM, cybersecurity, AI, data and cloud
- OP Infrastructure: infrastructure, energy and renewables
- OP Med-tech: medical devices and pharmaceuticals
- OP Engineering: engineering, procurement and logistics

## Services
Retained search, contingent search, contract & interim, Recruitment as a Service (RaaS)

## Offices
London (HQ), Newcastle, Dublin, Dortmund, New York, Miami
